source_of_authority: spec/architecture-lock.md (Section 2, Development workflow lock); spec/development-workflow.md (Section 2, Work-item lifecycle)
notes: Canonical, machine-readable definition of the ConstructionOS work-item lifecycle. The validator (tools/governance) enforces this definition against every record in governance/work-items/. Changing this file changes the process for all work items and is an architecture-adjacent change requiring Architect review.

roles.architect: Project Architect / Technical Reviewer. Owns architectural integrity, review, approval and verification decisions.
roles.product-owner: Product Owner / final authority. Owns product scope, priorities and approval of architecture-version changes.
roles.implementer: Implementation agent. Implements assigned work items and produces evidence. May not approve or verify its own work.
roles.automation: Deterministic automation (CI, bots) executing checks defined in this repository.

DRAFT.description: Work item is being authored. Objective, scope, acceptance criteria and evidence expectations are being defined.

READY.description: Work item is fully specified and eligible for assignment (see spec/00-readme.md, Definition of ready to implement).

ASSIGNED.description: Work item has been assigned to an implementer.

IMPLEMENTING.description: Assigned implementer is actively implementing the work item.

PR_OPEN.description: An implementation pull request is open and references the work item.

VERIFYING.description: Verification evidence is being produced and checked (automated checks, benchmarks, reproduction runs).

ARCHITECT_REVIEW.description: Evidence package is complete and awaits independent Architect review.

APPROVED.description: Architect has approved the implementation. Merge is authorized.

MERGED.description: The approved implementation pull request has been merged.

VERIFIED.description: Architect has recorded a verification decision binding acceptance evidence to the implementation revision. This is the only state that may be cited as completed work.

IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED.description: Work is blocked (missing dependency, unresolved decision, external impediment). Reachable from ASSIGNED, IMPLEMENTING and VERIFYING; returns to IMPLEMENTING once resolved.

ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE_REQUEST.description: Architect determined the work item requires a change to frozen architecture. Work pauses pending the Architecture Change Request process (see governance/README.md, Architecture changes).

evidence.policy: VERIFIED is never justified solely by implementation status, screenshots, demos or narrative claims (spec/architecture-lock.md LOCK-004). Every accepted evidence item must be reproducible and bound to the implementation revision (commit, pull request and/or CI run) it validates.

decision_rules.reverification_policy: A rejected or changes_requested decision must be followed by a transition back to IMPLEMENTING (changes_requested transition or verification_failed transition) before any later approval may take effect.
